title: The owner's notes on dc2a6c05 (sector shapes), six shipped: the Rotor's heat red, the opening's whites striding for the base, bodies rising from a sinkhole's lip, the canyon a column of 1,500 then 2,000 in a wider trench with its hole left open for SOL-82 to seal, the launcher clear of the boards, 'Ready for the next one?' without the laugh
context: Owner, 2026-10-15, on STALHEART dc2a6c05 ('getting better'): '1) the Rotor overheating should display as red 2) first batch of enemies with the rotor, they should move faster, with more obvious/longer appendage stretching towards the base, slow but menacing. 2) when they emerge out of a sinkhole, they should emerge from the periphery a bit, right now they emerge straight from the center, and it looks like they hover in the air. 3) the first batch of aliens with SOL, should be 5x to 10x more numerous, and from an open sinkhole that we will close with the SOL, educate the player. 4) sector 6, launching the second SOL, the launcher is too close to the ScoreBoard. Separate them. 5) Canyon SOL part 2, same, much too few enemies, and they are all stuck behind the rock and the walls, need more to feel satisfying, push the limits within our understanding of fps cost, knowing that soon they will be obliterated by the laser. 6) final line: Ready for the next one? Keep it but drop the last Ah Ah sound.' What was found behind each: (1) src/core/heat.js heatGlow ran red to orange to WHITE hot, so an overheated Rotor's barrels glowed white; the pilot panel's OVERHEATED line and the scope's status were plain. (2) the white tier hopped the gait's 2.4 radii a six-second cycle under a walk cap of 0.7 radii a second (PEARL_GAIT.hop for every tier, PEARL_PACE.radii). (2b) a body rose on a disc of `spread` (0.8 cells) round the breach's centre, inside the crater's 1-cell radius, so a Pearl body (drawn at the planet's radius, not the crater's floor) stood over the hole. (3, 5) the canyon's swarm was five two-breach pulses of the ladder wave (360 bodies) risen on one disc in a trench 2.4 cells wide; the hole was opened with `keep`, which kept it off the laser's list of breaches, and was spent (collapsed on its own) the moment its one wave was out, before the pass; the base's --canyon suite had been red on the base for the same reason (215 alive against 250 asked). (4) the ARC-01 launcher's island stood 10 m from the boards' slab (x -62 against the board at -38). (6) the recording ending_next_01 is 2.55 s: the line to 1.19 s, a breath, the laugh 1.60-2.20 s (ffmpeg silencedetect).
outcome: (1) heatGlow is red, redder, blazing red at the overheat (no white stage; its one reader is src/fx/barrel-heat.js); src/sentry-pilot.js marks the panel `overheat` while its line reads OVERHEATED (app.css: the output red); src/fx/story-scope.js shows OVERHEATED in red (HOT) before HOLD, READY or LOADING, fed by tower-combat's `overheated`. (2) PEARL_PACE.white: hop 3.6 radii (a tier's own stride over PEARL_GAIT.hop, src/fx/creature-pearl.js poolOf) and radii 0.85 (the walk cap, from 0.7; at 1 the hull touched the body while the record, which the ram kills, was still out of reach: a body hunts ahead of its record in proportion to the record's walk, and --pearl-story's ram probe found the white run over and alive); the cycle unchanged, so the hop is slow and reaches further; the bestiary stage stretches a tier's own stride by its `reach` too (src/fx/bestiary-stage.js; test/bestiary-stage.mjs holds the ratio). (2b) EMERGENCE.rim (src/content/story-defaults.js, 0.95): a body rises CONTENT.breach.craterRadius x rim plus sqrt(whim) x its spawn's `spread` out from the centre (src/fx/enemy-step.js spawnOne), the crater's lip and beyond, never over the hole; every breach, the opening's fifty and the canyon alike. Then the record GLIDES from where it rose onto its cell path over EMERGENCE.settle (4 s; the scatter beyond the rim EMERGENCE.scatter 0.5 of the spawn's spread, so the glide is at most ~13 m), an offset that decays like the shove's: snapping it back the moment the rise ended (as the old 0.8-cell disc did unnoticed) left a Pearl body a leash behind and put back, which --pearl-story's motion audit caught as pops (white in one run, black in the next, nine whites quietly re-placed; a 2.5 s glide over the full scatter still hurried the black tier to 0.26-0.28 radii a frame in its transfer, a hair over the audit's 0.25, in half the runs). (3, 5) CANYON: length 56, halfWidth 2.5 (5 cells wide), bodies { first: 1500, again: 2000 } sized through sizeWave in the ladder's mix with the row's coreShare, fill 0.6, spread 0.8; src/domain/canyon.js returns the floor deep end first; src/fx/sector-run.js waveOf hands the swarm a `column` (the deepest `fill` of the floor) and queueOf gives the k-th body the cell its share of the column falls in (the spawn's `cell`, as the opening's head start), so the swarm stands as a column from the hole outward and the pass sweeps down it; the canyon's breach is opened without `keep` (the laser lists it: the beam seals it as a sinkhole, and the pass starts over it) and the spend loop leaves it open until the canyon's phase is done, then it collapses on its own if the beam never touched it. `swarm` retired. The frame: 1,500 bodies at once is the column the headed measurement held (2026-10-15-pearl-crowd-measured-headed); CROWD_CAP (1,500 at best) holds the rest queued; the canyon again's 2,000 lean on the cap by design (the owner: push the limits). (4) the launcher's island at x -74: 22 m clear of the boards, 7 m of HUGIN and the radar as before, inside the clearing (test/base-plan.mjs). (6) the export's wav (../seiyu_voice/export, the source of truth) cut at 1.30 s with an 80 ms fade, the full take kept beside it as ending_next_01.full.wav, the manifest's text 'Ready for the next one?' and duration 1.3, node scripts/import-isao-voice.mjs re-run: one mp3, the table's one line and the lock's one entry changed; committed there as d2671c4. Not measured: the whites' new walk by the clock (the owner judges by eye), the canyon's frame at 1,500 and 2,000 on his machine.
alternatives: Keep white hot and only colour the HUD: rejected; the owner said red, and the barrels are what he looks at.
A faster cycle for the whites: rejected; 'slow but menacing' is the cycle kept and the stride lengthened.
Emerge the bodies on the crater's floor height instead of its lip: the Pearl bodies are drawn on the planet's radius by the kit; the lip is where the ground is, and the owner asked for the periphery.
Ten times the canyon (3,600): the column the frame held headed was 1,200-1,500; 1,500 and 2,000 with the crowd cap as the guard, the numbers the owner tunes on :8159.
A text line from Isao about sealing the hole ('educate the player'): not added; the lines are the owner's recordings, and the beam over the open hole is the lesson.
evidence: node test/sector-run.mjs (the canyon's count, the column over the fake floor's deep fill, the hole live under the pass and collapsed after), test/canyon.mjs, test/base-plan.mjs, test/bestiary-stage.mjs, test/pearl-enemies.mjs; npm test (257), npm run check, npm run build
ffprobe/silencedetect on assets/audio/isao/ending_next_01.mp3: speech 0.17-1.19 s, the laugh 1.60-2.20 s; the trimmed wav 1.300 s

browser suites on the round, 2026-10-15: --canyon green (it had been red on the base at 215 alive against 250 asked: the column of 1,500 fills it), --canyon-again, --sectors, --opening, --sinkhole, --laser, --seats, --colony, --bestiary, --skip-tutorial, --units-sky, --chapters green; --base red at the default suite's shell-explosion as on the base; --pearl-story green three runs in a row after the settle and the cap (the motion audit 0/0 pops on every tier, the base itself re-placing 13 whites to this build's 4-9; the ram probe killing its white at first contact in every run), having been red on its audit (black 4 pops in the transfer at 0.26-0.28 radii a frame, the 2.5 s glide) and once on its ram (the cap at 1) before them
